full_name: Chika O. Okafor | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Social Sciences Edna Newman Shapiro, Class of 1936, and Robert Newman Shapiro, Class of 1972, Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Chika O. Okafor is a PhD candidate in economics at Harvard University, and the inaugural Academic Fellow in Law and Political Economy at Harvard Law School, and he is broadly interested in how contemporary American society defines justice and how public opinion and social networks motivate US institutions to promote or restrict justice in response to major economic and social problems.
